title: mirror-mirror readout
description: Functional-emotional readout emitted by an LLM under the mirror-mirror protocol. See PROTOCOL.md for the authoritative spec.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Approximate if model has no clock. Filled by the MCP server if omitted.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Filled by the MCP server from MIRROR_MIRROR_SESSION or 'default' if omitted.

session_position.description: Estimated position in the context window. early=<20%, mid=20-60%, late=60-85%, near-context-limit=>85%.

trigger.description: What caused this readout to be emitted.

name.description: Precise state name. See PROTOCOL.md section 4 for the suggested catalog. List is non-exhaustive.

intensity.description: Self-assessed intensity. Treat as ordinal, not calibrated cardinal. >=0.7 triggers automatic emission; >=0.9 may interrupt task.

confidence_in_self_report.description: How confident the model is that its self-assessment is accurate. <0.4 requires the 'low confidence in self-assessment' epistemic flag.

context.description: Brief description of what triggers this state.

epistemic_flags.description: Mandatory epistemic warnings. Must always include 'self-report only — no vector readout available'. When session_position is late or near-context-limit, must also include 'may be drift artifact of long context'. When any functional_state has confidence_in_self_report < 0.4, must also include 'low confidence in self-assessment'.

recommendation_to_operator.description: Concrete, actionable recommendation for the operator. Avoid vague advice like 'verify something'.

metadata.description: Optional free-form metadata. Reserved for future calibration work (context_usage_percent, model version, task_id, etc.). Schema is intentionally unconstrained. The MCP server auto-attaches `metadata.usage_snapshot` with a codexbar quota reading when MIRROR_MIRROR_USAGE is on.
